seo.title: Inti Raymi Festival Tour in Cusco 2026
seo.description: Join the Inti Raymi Festival 2026 in Cusco, Peru, and experience one of the most iconic Inca cultural celebrations in South America.

summary: Join the Inti Raymi Festival 2026 in Cusco, Peru, and experience one of the most iconic Inca cultural celebrations in South America.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Inti Raymi: the Festival of the Sun - Qoricancha – Plaza de Armas – Sacsayhuaman (07 hr tour)
itinerary.body: In the morning, at the agreed time, we will meet at the Qoricancha (Cerco de oro): In Inca times it was the main temple consecrated to the sun, there we will observe the first rituals of worship of the Apu Inti and the Pacha Mama, then we will go to the Plaza de Armas (the ancient Waqaypata or Warrior’s Square), in this immense square the ceremony took place entirely in the middle of the large ushnu or ceremonial platform. Afterwards, to end with the most extraordinary scene and the greatest celebration, we will go to Sacsayhuaman (a voice that derives from the Quechua terms “saqsay” and “waman” which translated into Spanish means “satiate falcon”), finally we will return to the hotel in Cusco.
